items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: my mother's maiden name was Margaret Webb

ctx.x: Beautiful. And your parent's name was Cliff?

Well, my father's name was Merle, Merle Leeman. And my mother's maiden name was Margaret Webb -- W-e-b-b. They were both from Maine, my father was born in Portland, Maine, as was I. My mother, I believe, was born in Portland, Maine. I have that all in the family Bible. I have a real old Bible that goes back to the early 1800's, by the way.
What kind of work did your father do?
